title: Design and development of a digital, evidence-based nutrition tool for people living with chronic inflammatory bowel diseases
summary: The aim of the project is to develop and carry out a user-centred evaluation of the ‘IBDNutriNavigator’, a digital application providing nutritional support for people with Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis. Based on current guidelines and scientific literature, the aim is to develop a rule-based system that selects and presents general nutritional information and advice in a clear and accessible manner, taking into account the situation, symptoms and food intolerances specified by the users.

interventions.name: Patients with chronic inflammatory bowel diseases will use the study tool for 4 weeks and will be asked to complete online questionnaires at the start and end of the study regarding their dietary habits, their condition, and their satisfaction with and ease of use of the tool.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•Age ≥ 18 years
•Confirmed diagnosis of IBD (Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis) for > 3 months
•Sufficient knowledge of German to complete questionnaires and take part in interviews
•Capacity to give consent
Exclusion criteria:
•an acute, severe phase of illness that prevents participation in a questionnaire or interview
•insufficient knowledge of German
•lack of a declaration of consent
